title: International Observe the Moon Night 2026
description: Join SEDS Sri Lanka and SEDS India for an interactive virtual celebration of International Observe the Moon Night 2026. Experience live high-definition lunar telescopic streaming provided by SEDS Celestia, guided scientific sessions, and interactive discussions.
shortDescription: Annual global celebration of lunar science and exploration with SEDS Sri Lanka in collaboration with SEDS India, featuring live lunar telescope streaming powered by SEDS Celestia.

agenda.title: Inauguration & Joint Collaboration Briefing
agenda.description: Welcome address by SEDS Sri Lanka & SEDS India leadership, live broadcast introduction, and telescope imaging overview powered by SEDS Celestia.

agenda.title: Lunar Science Keynote: Maria Formation & Historic Landing Sites
agenda.description: Scientific presentation on lunar basalt maria (Sea of Rains & Sea of Tranquility), impact cratering, and geology of Apollo 11 & Apollo 15 landing sites.

agenda.title: Live Telescopic Observation Kickoff (Visible Sights: Plato Crater & Alpine Valley)
agenda.description: Live telescope feed goes live! High-resolution observation of the dark lava-filled floor of Plato Crater and the dramatic lunar rift of the Alpine Valley (Vallis Alpes) slicing through the northern highlands.

agenda.title: Highland Peaks & Apollo Sites (Visible Sights: Apennine Mountains & Apollo 15)
agenda.description: Close-up inspection of the towering Apennine Mountains (Montes Apenninus) rising over 5,000 meters along the terminator, plus the Hadley Rille canyon and Apollo 15 landing region.

agenda.title: Lunar Faults & Volcanic Vents (Visible Sights: Straight Wall & Alphonsus Crater)
agenda.description: Telescopic exploration of the Straight Wall (Rupes Recta)—a famous 110-km lunar fault escarpment casting sharp shadows—along with Alphonsus Crater's central peak and the Catena Davy craterlet chain.

agenda.title: Live Moon Trivia Quiz, Q&A & Certificate Wrap-Up
agenda.description: Interactive live astronomy trivia quiz, audience Q&A with telescope operators and astrophysicists, and digital participation certificate announcements before concluding at 11:00 PM.
